Read a long PDF by its pages. More at [www.malgel.com](https://www.malgel.com).

## New

- **Page thumbnails in the PDF viewer.** The button at the left of the viewer's toolbar opens a strip of every page beside the document. Click a thumbnail to jump to that page; the page you are reading is marked, and jumping to a page brings its thumbnail into view. The strip scrolls on its own, so you can browse it without moving the document, and the viewer keeps its fit-width / fit-page zoom while it is open.
  - Thumbnails are the same vector sheets the pages are drawn from, rendered on demand as they scroll into view and cached, so a long document does not pay for them twice.
  - The palette has the same command, **PDF page thumbnails**.

## Downloads

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11+ (Apple silicon) | `Malgel-0.1.6-macos-arm64.dmg`: open it and drag Malgel to Applications |
| Windows 10+ | `Malgel-0.1.6-windows-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Malgel-0.1.6-windows-x64.zip` (portable) |
| Linux x86_64 | `Malgel-0.1.6-x86_64.AppImage` (`chmod +x` it, then run it) or `malgel-0.1.6-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

The macOS app is signed ad hoc and not notarized, so Gatekeeper blocks it after download: right-click it and choose Open once, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Malgel.app`. The Windows files are unsigned: SmartScreen may warn, and **More info → Run anyway** gets past it. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.
